name: Unix Timestamp Converter
summary: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back — locally in your browser.
description: Paste a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds to see ISO-8601, UTC, and local time. Or paste an ISO date to get seconds and milliseconds. Auto-detects the unit from magnitude.

faqs.question: Seconds or milliseconds?
faqs.answer: We auto-detect from the number's magnitude. Typical second timestamps are ~10 digits; milliseconds are ~13.

faqs.question: Is my timestamp sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What timezone is Local?
faqs.answer: Your browser's current timezone, via the platform Date API.
